_note: Frozen content for design review. Dark family where the figure is the image — one measured effect per page, set at display scale, with the argument underneath.
brief: Six changes and what each one actually moved

slots.tag: Every team tries all six. Only one of them reliably changes how long work takes, and it is not the one anybody expects.

slots.titleLine1: Small changes are not less ambitious
slots.body: Large scope is not ambition, it is deferred learning. Every week between deciding and shipping is a week spent guessing about what people wanted.

slots.stat1L: of blocked items were waiting on nobody in particular
slots.titleLine1: Committees do not decide, they schedule
slots.body: One named person gathering input and choosing is faster, and when it goes wrong it is fixable by that same person rather than by another meeting.

slots.stat1L: median wait, down from a day and a half
slots.titleLine1: A change waiting is not idle, it is rotting
slots.body: Context leaves the author's head within hours. The longer a change sits, the slower the review becomes, which is the queue feeding itself.

slots.stat1L: handoff meetings left on the calendar
slots.titleLine1: The meeting existed because the work was sequential
slots.body: Design explaining itself to engineering is a symptom of working in order. Working in the same file removes the meeting entirely rather than shortening it.

slots.stat1L: per decision, written the day it was made
slots.titleLine1: Teams re-argue settled decisions every quarter
slots.body: Not because anyone forgot the decision, but because nobody recorded why it was made. The record is what stops the same discussion recurring.

slots.stepTag: The one that did not work
slots.stat1L: measurable effect from changing the tools
slots.titleLine1: Software makes a good process faster, not a bad one good
slots.body: Every team with this exact stack still ships slowly if a decision waits on approval. Change who decides before changing what they decide in.

slots.statL: change, made this week, measured next month
slots.headline: Pick the place
slots.subline: Not all six. Find the single step where things sit longest and remove the wait. Then measure it, because the ones that feel productive rarely are.
slots.signoff: The measuring is the part everyone skips
